profiles.description: One Human Principal may operate several Agent Identities with lightweight repository coordination.

Several Human Principals use clone-local actor binding, sponsor Agent Identities, qualify Position memberships, and govern scoped authority through repository evidence; real multi-human validation remains a separate gate.
Risk-driven evidence, approval, rollback, and separation-of-duties gates backed by local exact-revision records; representative and High-Assurance drills remain separate validation gates.
